title: BITMAX crypto-asset lending service launch announcement
notes: Issuer-distributed LINE release establishing service launch on 2020-10-07. The launch campaign rate is an issuer term, not verified realized return.

title: LINE BITMAX crypto-asset lending help
notes: First-party help material describes users lending crypto assets to the operator in exchange for lending fees and documents variable-period and fixed-period product types. Product limits/rates are time-sensitive.

title: LINE Xenesis announces LINE BITMAX service shutdown
notes: First-party group announcement establishing planned LINE BITMAX shutdown on 2026-06-01 and the shutdown rationale as management-resource reallocation amid changing market conditions and competition.

title: LINE BITMAX service-end information
notes: Official shutdown site states lending applications were stopped, existing lending contracts would be ended sequentially, and remaining balances would be handled under the announced service-end return procedure. This does not prove universal historical lending repayment.
